title: Kenyan BBQ Chicken Wings
community: Urban Kenya — the universal restaurant starter
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan BBQ Chicken Wings — marinated chicken wings baked until crispy and lacquered with a Kenyan honey-chilli-tamarind glaze. The most ordered starter in Nairobi's restaurants — sweet, sticky, and deeply addictive.
longDesc: BBQ chicken wings are the restaurant starter that tables fight over — crispy-skinned, deeply glazed, and eaten with hands regardless of the restaurant's formality. The Kenyan version uses a honey-tamarind glaze that is simultaneously sweet, tart, and warming.
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings — tips removed, split at joint
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C. Place wings on a rack over a baking tray.
Bake for 20 minutes. Flip. Bake 10 more minutes.
Make glaze: simmer all glaze ingredients for 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Brush wings generously with glaze. Bake 5 minutes.
Flip, glaze again. Bake final 5 minutes.
The wings should be deeply lacquered and sticky.
Serve with extra glaze for dipping.
chefTips: The rack is essential — it allows air circulation for crispier skin.
Multiple glaze applications build the lacquer.
Serve immediately — wings lose crispiness quickly.
commonMistakes: No rack — wings sit in fat and steam instead of crisping.
cookingScience: The rack allows hot air to circulate underneath the wings, creating convective cooking on all surfaces simultaneously. Without a rack, the bottom surface sits in the rendered fat and produces a flabby, steamed result. Multiple glaze applications build successive caramelised layers.
sustainabilityTips: Chicken wings use the part of the bird that would otherwise be undervalued.
healthBenefits: Tamarind adds iron and B vitamins.
Best enjoyed as a restaurant treat.
culturalNote: BBQ chicken wings have become one of Kenya's most beloved restaurant starters — the dish that every table orders regardless of what else is coming. The Kenyan honey-tamarind glaze transforms a universal dish into something unmistakably local.
